Class.summary: Controller responsible for recording and querying billable and operational work hours logged on support tickets.
Class.remarks: Route prefix: api/v1/tickets/{ticketId}/time-entries. All time entry endpoints require authentication and enforce role-based access control.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The MediatR mediator instance used for dispatching time entry queries and commands.
The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role from JWT claims.

GetTimeEntries.summary: Retrieves all work logs and cumulative total duration recorded for a specific ticket.
GetTimeEntries.remarks: Restricted to users with the Admin role or the SupportAgent assigned to the ticket. Customers are strictly forbidden from viewing time entry details. Returns: Entries: Individual time log items (entry ID, logging agent display name, work date, duration in minutes, description, and created timestamp). TotalMinutesLogged: Aggregated total minutes recorded on this ticket.
GetTimeEntries.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the parent ticket.
GetTimeEntries.returns: The time entries response object containing the log records and total logged minutes.
GetTimeEntries.response: Returns the list of time entries and aggregated work duration.
If the provided ticket ID is not a valid GUID format.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller is a customer or a support agent not assigned to this ticket.
If the ticket does not exist.

AddTimeEntry.summary: Logs a new work duration entry against a specific support ticket.
AddTimeEntry.remarks: Restricted exclusively to users in the SupportAgent role. The caller must be the specific Support Agent assigned to this ticket. WorkDate: Cannot be a future date. DurationMinutes: Must be between 1 and 1440 minutes (up to 24 hours). Description: Required work summary, maximum 500 characters. Automatically logs a TimeLogged activity event in the ticket audit trail.
AddTimeEntry.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the parent ticket.
The time entry payload containing work date, duration in minutes, and description.
AddTimeEntry.response: If the payload fails validation (e.g., future work date, duration < 1 or > 1440, missing description).
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the SupportAgent role.
If the ticket was not found or is not assigned to the calling agent.
